listing.name: Va11 Hall-A Portrait Pack
listing.summary: I made a va11 character portrait pack. it has 28 characters. it took me 3 hours to make, which is 2 1/2 hours more than it would have taken if photoshop could cooperate. Install this mod, play as a va11 character, go wild, not too wild, you know what? go as wild as you want to, im not stopping you
listing.aiSummary: Adds 28 character portraits based on the game VA-11 Hall-A.
